Part window "Part1 *" (the active one)
  Feature tree:
    Part1
      Origin
      Sketch1
  Timeline (# | Feature | Type | Parameters | Status):
    1 | Sketch1 | Sketch (Rectangle) | 20 x 20 mm at (0, 0) | OK
  View (x 170 to 793, y 73 to 451; drag in it to orbit, right-drag to pan): wireframe, 4 edges. Seen from yaw 135, pitch 35
Cal, the caliper assistant, is in the corner. It says: It looks like you're drawing a box. / Would you like help?
  button [Get help with drawing the box]
  button [Just draw the box without help]
  button [Don't show me this tip again]
Status bar: Sketch1 created: 20 x 20 mm at (0, 0)   Clock: 10:41 AM
Tutor: Sketch1 is a flat sketch. menu Features > Extrude... makes it solid. Cal is only a helper: any of Cal's buttons sends Cal away. "how <words>" looks things up, e.g. how hole. Say "yes" to do: menu Features > Extrude...

Status bar: Ready   Clock: 10:41 AM
